guideline: Annotator labeled each generated feedback comment as appropriate, partially appropriate, or inappropriate; partially appropriate refers to the case that a generation result would become appropriate if part of it were edited. Specifically, we set the following two conditions: (1) the type of error is correctly identified, and (2) replacing a few words makes it appropriate.
